The card's explanation already cites § 6, т. 3, т. 4, т. 6 and чл. 15, ал. 5. So the citation stays, and whether ал. 1's first half survives ал. 2, т. 2 on a town street with two or more lanes one way (the ONLY roads where the reading matters: 213 committed multi-lane town edges) is owed to the founder / a legal reading
